verdict.rationale: Radar lets users set up custom rules that run automatically against every payment attempt: block, request 3DS, auto-allow trusted customers, and auto-pause payouts on high-dispute accounts. Risk settings also adjust thresholds on their own. These automations are limited to fraud-decision rules, though, and community reports cite weak programmatic control and Allow Rules being gated behind support. missing for 10: general-purpose or scheduled background automations beyond payment-time rule evaluation, agent-driven or programmatic rule management, independent hands-on corroboration of autonomous automation workflows.
